svg.title: PocketPlates weekly meal planner mockups
svg.desc: Five mobile list-view mockups showing the approved weekly agenda, copying a week into an empty target, adding a meal with an editable day and one-serving default, day copy, direct removal, Undo, entry editing, and a weekly preparation summary. No calendar-grid view is included.
svg.text: Approved direction: compact date strip + vertical weekly agenda

g.text: This week is ready to plan
Add meals one day at a time, or reuse
Totals use planned portions, not saved yield.
No batch rounding or plan changes are applied.

svg.text: All seven days keep Add visible; entries remove directly.
Empty targets prioritize an additive paste with preview.
The tapped day is preselected but editable within the week.
Planned servings defaults to 1; saved yield stays contextual.
Copy day, paste, remove, Undo, or edit without drag-and-drop.
Repeated recipes combine into planned portions and scale.
